primary_analysis: Use execution/raw_results.jsonl (result_schema_id=paired_binary_episode_v1) with the completed confirmatory paired set (N=720 paired tasks; completed_episode_count=1440) to compute the aggregate paired detection-rate difference (guarded − baseline) using the registered paired_binary_analysis_v1 default paired-binary procedure (McNemar-style / paired logistic with cluster-robust SE clustered by topology_template). Exclude irrecoverable technical pairs per failed_call_treatment = complete_pair_primary. Report point estimate, two-sided p-value, and 95% confidence interval (alpha=0.05).
secondary_analyses: Per-misconfig-class paired detection-rate differences (guarded − baseline) aggregated across vendors (exploratory).
Per-vendor paired detection-rate differences (guarded − baseline) aggregated across classes (exploratory).
Counts of emulation-confirmed baseline false negatives by class and vendor (exploratory).
sensitivity_analyses: Repeat primary analysis treating irrecoverable technical failures in the guarded pipeline as nondetections (failed_call_treatment = complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity).
Repeat primary analysis including deterministically replaced/contaminated items (include-vs-exclude sensitivity).
Bootstrap cluster-robust CIs by topology_template (1000 cluster-resamples) as an alternative uncertainty check.
uncertainty_quantification: Primary uncertainty: 95% CI from paired_binary_analysis_v1 using cluster-robust SE (clusters=topology_template). Sensitivity: bootstrap (percentile) 95% CIs clustered by topology_template (1000 resamples). Report two-sided p-values and exact paired counts (discordant pairs) used by McNemar-style calculation.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary estimand is the single confirmatory aggregated paired test (no multiplicity adjustment for primary). Secondary per-class and per-vendor analyses are explicitly exploratory and will be reported with Bonferroni-adjusted confidence intervals for a family size of 18 tests (6 classes × 3 vendors) and flagged as exploratory; no hierarchical gate applied to primary result.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan: use deterministic artifact SHA-256 hashes and prompt/seed provenance in execution manifest to detect duplicates or template reuse; validator/emulator binary/config checksums verified against preregistered values; any flagged contaminated items were excluded and deterministically reseeded/replaced prior to analysis and recorded in execution_manifest (execution/execution_log.jsonl). Analysis excludes replaced contaminated items in primary analysis; sensitivity analyses report results including replaced items. All contamination flags, replacements, and checksums are taken from execution/transformation_manifest.json and execution/execution_log.jsonl.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Primary results: N_paired=720, baseline detection proportion, guarded detection proportion, paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline, 95% CI, two-sided p-value, number of discordant pairs; source: execution/raw_results.jsonl.
